# uRecruits

uRecruits is building a recruiter-first platform with an explicit design constraint: "a human in every decision." The version 2.0 launch (June 2026) shipped seven connected capabilities and "uR Agent" AI that drafts jobs, sends pre-screens, coordinates interviews, and ranks candidates — but makes no automated advancement, rejection, or hire decisions. Every consequential call stays human-approved. For compliance-sensitive TA leaders, uRecruits is betting human-in-the-loop is a competitive differentiator as state and federal AI hiring laws tighten. The trade-off: keeping humans in every loop limits scaling at high volume compared to fully agentic competitors.
